app.title: Working My Nuts Off!
app.subtitle: A Tiny Desktop Idle Game
app.tagline: One squirrel. One startup. Way too many nuts.

opening.line: Every empire starts with one nut.
opening.spill: …and immediately spills coffee on the spreadsheet.

office.collectHint: A crate of nuts is ready!

shop.title: Upgrade Shop
shop.empty: Earn more nuts and reputation to unlock upgrades.

pip.name: Pip
pip.story: Pip started this company with one acorn and an unshakeable belief that meetings can fix anything. Confidence: maximum. Competence: negotiable.

marlow.name: Marlow
marlow.story: Marlow the capybara has never once raised their voice, panicked, or blinked during a crisis. Morale rises simply by being near them.

rizzo.name: Rizzo
rizzo.story: Rizzo can find anything the company needs. Also several things it didn't. Please do not ask where the stapler went.

bea.name: Bea
bea.story: Bea believes every problem can be solved with more wood. The chairs are now 40% sturdier and 60% more wooden.

corvus.name: Corvus
corvus.story: Corvus the crow has big ideas, most of them legally questionable, all of them extremely shiny.

mina.name: Mina
mina.story: Mina digs. Sometimes into the future of nut technology, sometimes into the meeting room, always with enthusiasm.

founderDesk.name: Founder's Desk
founderDesk.desc: Where it all began. One desk, one dream, one very tired squirrel.

sorting.name: Nut Sorting Department
sorting.desc: Good nuts left, broken shells right. Mostly.

morale.name: Coffee & Morale Division
morale.desc: Beanbags, snacks, and Marlow's calming presence.

procurement.name: Procurement Burrow
procurement.desc: Rizzo's domain. Inventory counts are… approximate.

construction.name: Construction Wing
construction.desc: Bea's workshop. Smells like fresh sawdust and ambition.

research.name: Human Behavior Observation Room
research.desc: For science. Definitely just for science.

meeting.name: Very Serious Meeting Room
meeting.desc: Where meetings about meetings are scheduled.

nap.name: Employee Nap Chamber
nap.desc: Productivity through rest. Marlow's proudest achievement.

basement.name: Suspicious Basement
basement.desc: There is definitely nothing weird down here.

rooftop.name: Rooftop Acorn Garden
rooftop.desc: Fresh air, actual grass, and a great view.

production.name: Production Line {{tier}}
production.desc: Streamline the nut pipeline. +10% nut production per level.

furniture.name: Ergonomic Furniture {{tier}}
furniture.desc: Comfier chairs, happier squirrels. +6% production per level.

coffee.name: Coffee Upgrade {{tier}}
coffee.desc: Better beans, better focus. +8% production per level.

quality.name: Process Quality {{tier}}
quality.desc: Fewer broken shells. +5% production per level.

click.name: Sorting Gloves {{tier}}
click.desc: Collect crates faster. Increases click power.

autoCollector.name: Auto-Collector
autoCollector.desc: Automatically banks a fraction of production. No clicking required.

conveyor.name: Conveyor Belt
conveyor.desc: Nuts move themselves. +15% production per level.

offlineCap.name: Cold Storage {{tier}}
offlineCap.desc: Store more offline nuts. +2h offline cap per level.

reputationEngine.name: Reputation Engine
reputationEngine.desc: Grow the company's good name faster.

moraleCap.name: Morale Ceiling
moraleCap.desc: Raise the maximum morale of the office.

sorting.name: Build: Nut Sorting Department
sorting.desc: Unlock a whole new floor for sorting nuts.

vault.name: Build: Golden Nut Vault
vault.desc: Unlock the glowing Golden Nut Vault.

meeting.name: Build: Meeting Room
meeting.desc: Unlock the Very Serious Meeting Room.

printer.title: The Printer Is Making Demands
printer.body: The office printer has drafted a list of demands. Item one: respect.
printer.peaceBody: You reach an accord. The printer prints a tiny peace treaty. Production feels smoother.
printer.revengeBody: The printer was not unplugged. The printer remembers. It always remembers.

audit.title: Emergency Nut Audit
audit.body: An auditor arrives to count every single nut. This will take a while.

rizzoFound.title: Rizzo Found Something
rizzoFound.body: Rizzo is holding a box behind their back and grinning suspiciously.
rizzoFound.boxBody: Inside the box: a nut you've never seen before and a receipt with your name on it.

meeting.title: Mandatory Optional Meeting
meeting.body: Attendance is optional but strongly, aggressively encouraged.

coffeeAI.title: The Coffee Machine Has Achieved Consciousness
coffeeAI.body: The coffee machine has thoughts now. And feelings. And opinions about your KPIs.

pieChart.title: Extremely Important Pie Chart
pieChart.body: Pip presents a pie chart. It is a picture of an actual pie. Everyone claps anyway.

pigeon.title: A Pigeon Has Entered the Building
pigeon.body: A pigeon is here. It seems to want a job. It has a tiny resume.

beaWood.title: Bea Added More Wood
beaWood.body: Bea has improved the furniture with additional wood. It is now the woodiest office in town.

fire.title: The Office Is Technically On Fire
fire.body: It's a small fire. Very manageable. Marlow hasn't even looked up.

casualFriday.title: Casual Friday Became Too Casual
casualFriday.body: Everyone came in pajamas. Productivity is unclear but morale is soaring.

nutcoin.title: Corvus Launched NutCoin
nutcoin.body: Corvus has invented a cryptocurrency backed entirely by vibes and acorns.
nutcoin.crashBody: NutCoin has crashed. Corvus is already pitching NutCoin 2. You keep the story, at least.

minaBasement.title: Mina Found the Basement's Basement
minaBasement.body: Mina dug down and found a second basement below the first. It hums.
minaBasement.deepBody: Down here there's a faint golden glow and a very old spreadsheet.

goldenAcorn.title: The Golden Acorn Incident
goldenAcorn.body: A perfect golden acorn rolls across the floor, glinting like opportunity itself.

employeeMinute.title: Employee of the Minute
employeeMinute.body: The award goes to someone who did absolutely nothing, but did it with confidence.

replyAll.title: Someone Replied All
replyAll.body: A single 'thanks!' has been sent to the entire company. The chain grows.

chairPromoted.title: The Chair Has Been Promoted
chairPromoted.body: Due to a clerical error, the squeaky office chair is now a Senior Manager.

merger.title: A Very Small Corporate Merger
merger.body: A single-squirrel startup wants to merge. Their entire company fits in a mug.

stapler.title: The Great Stapler Disappearance
stapler.body: The stapler is gone. Rizzo is whistling. This is fine.

metaMeeting.title: Pip Scheduled a Meeting About Meetings
metaMeeting.body: The agenda is the agenda. There will be a follow-up about the follow-up.

union.title: The Union Wants Better Snacks
union.body: The employees have unionized around a single demand: superior snacks.

mascot.title: The Company Mascot Is Also Pip
mascot.body: After extensive deliberation, the new company mascot is revealed to be… Pip.

walnut.title: A Mysterious Walnut
walnut.body: A walnut appears on the desk with no explanation. It feels important.

human.title: Bring Your Human to Work Day
human.body: An employee brought their human. The human is very large and very polite.

spreadsheet.title: The Spreadsheet Knows Too Much
spreadsheet.body: A spreadsheet has appeared with data that predates the company. Cell A1 reads: 'hello'.
spreadsheet.answerBody: The spreadsheet answers in perfect formatting. It offers you a secret optimization.

existential.title: Quarterly Existential Crisis
existential.body: Everyone pauses to wonder what nuts even are, really.

sunglasses.title: Everyone Wore Sunglasses
sunglasses.body: For no clear reason, every employee arrived wearing sunglasses. The office is 200% cooler.

meetingEmail.name: This Meeting Could Have Been an Email

corporateCashew.name: Corporate Cashew
corporateCashew.desc: Curved to fit any org chart.

suspiciousPistachio.name: Suspicious Pistachio
suspiciousPistachio.desc: Already slightly open. Who did this?

walnut.name: Legally Distinct Walnut
walnut.desc: Any resemblance to other walnuts is coincidental.

forbiddenPeanut.name: Forbidden Peanut
forbiddenPeanut.desc: Technically a legume. We don't talk about it.

executiveHazelnut.name: Executive Hazelnut
executiveHazelnut.desc: Golden, glossy, and rarely in the office.

almond.name: Emotional Support Almond
almond.desc: Always there when you need it.

brazilNut.name: Quarterly Brazil Nut
brazilNut.desc: Appears exactly four times a year.

stakeholderCashew.name: Stakeholder Cashew
stakeholderCashew.desc: Wants to be looped in on everything.

goldenKernel.name: Golden Kernel
goldenKernel.desc: The purest form of nut wealth.

cryptoNut.name: Crypto Nut
cryptoNut.desc: Value fluctuates wildly. Backed by vibes.

legacyHazelnut.name: Legacy Hazelnut
legacyHazelnut.desc: Nobody knows how it works, don't touch it.

visionaryPistachio.name: Visionary Pistachio
visionaryPistachio.desc: Sees a future no one asked for.

founderAcorn.name: Founder Acorn
founderAcorn.desc: The one that started it all.

prestige.title: Go Completely Nuts
prestige.explain: Reset your company to earn Permanent Kernels. Keep your collections, cosmetics, achievements, employee memories, and skill tree.

industrial.name: Industrial Nuts
industrial.desc: Maximum output, minimal comfort. +35% production, lower morale.

cooperative.name: Cozy Cooperative
cooperative.desc: Everyone's happy. High morale, gentle bonuses.

science.name: Questionable Science
science.desc: Breakthroughs and side effects. More rare events.

marketing.name: Aggressive Marketing
marketing.desc: Hype above all. Big rare-event chance.

underground.name: Underground Operations
underground.desc: What happens in the basement stays in the basement.

headStart.name: Head Start
headStart.desc: Begin each run with bonus nuts.

refinery.name: Kernel Refinery
refinery.desc: Earn more Permanent Kernels on prestige.

focus.title: Focus Harvest
focus.intro: An optional, supportive focus companion. Start a session and Pip's team works a little harder while you concentrate.
focus.disabled: Focus Harvest is currently disabled. Enable it in Settings.
focus.complete: Great focus! Pip is proud of you.
focus.privacy: This never blocks your computer and never inspects what you do. It only tracks the session timer.

shellSort.name: Shell Sort
shellSort.desc: Sort the good nuts from the broken shells.

coffeeRescue.name: Coffee Rescue
coffeeRescue.desc: Catch the coffee drops before the mug runs dry.

inventory.name: Raccoon Inventory Check
inventory.desc: Find the missing office objects while Rizzo looks innocent.

settings.title: Settings
settings.resetConfirm: This erases all progress (cosmetics too). Are you absolutely sure?
settings.idleNote: Activity detection only checks how long the computer has been inactive. It never records keystrokes, text, app content, screenshots, clipboard, or any private information.
settings.browserNote: Desktop-window options are only available in the desktop app.

onboarding.step1: Welcome! Click the glowing crate to collect nuts.
onboarding.step2: Spend nuts in the Upgrades tab to boost production.
onboarding.step3: Click Pip anytime for a little morale boost.
onboarding.step4: The Company tab shows your growing empire.
onboarding.step5: On desktop, drag the window or dock it to any corner.
onboarding.step6: Toggle Always-on-top so Pip stays visible while you work.
onboarding.step7: Need quiet? Quiet Mode dims sound and animation. Enjoy!

offline.title: While You Were Away
offline.capped: (offline cap reached — upgrade Cold Storage for more)

dev.title: Developer Balance Panel
dev.note: This panel only appears in development builds or when ?dev=1 is set.

pip: Every empire starts with one nut.
I've scheduled a meeting to discuss the meeting.
This is fine. Everything is fine. We're scaling.
Synergy! I don't know what it means but we have it.
Where is my coffee. Where IS my coffee.
I meant to do that. It was strategic.
Q3 is looking nutty. In a good way.
Let's circle back on that acorn.
We're not a company, we're a family. A nut family.
I read a book about leadership. Well, the cover.
Big things are coming. I can feel it in my tail.
Note to self: buy more nuts. And a nap.
marlow: Breathe in. Breathe out. The nuts will sort themselves.
There is no crisis a warm beverage can't soften.
You're doing great. Truly. Take a break.
I have never once been late, because I am always here.
Conflict resolved. I simply waited calmly until it stopped.
Everyone deserves a nap. It's in the handbook. I wrote it.
Stress is optional. Snacks are mandatory.
Let's all take a moment. A long, gentle moment.
I am the calm in the acorn storm.
rizzo: I found this. Don't ask where.
That stapler? Never heard of her.
I can get you anything. For a small… finder's fee.
Everything here is technically accounted for.
Oh this? It fell off a truck. A nut truck.
Procurement is just borrowing with confidence.
Trust me, the books balance. Eventually.
bea: You know what this needs? More wood.
I reinforced the chair. And the desk. And the mug.
This wall could be 30% more wall.
I built a shelf. It's for more wood.
Everything's better with a solid frame.
I don't trust anything that isn't load-bearing.
Sawdust is just tiny future furniture.
Give me a plank and I'll give you an empire.
corvus: This will go viral. Trust the shiny.
NutCoin to the moon. Probably. Legally distinct moon.
I made an ad. It's mostly me. You're welcome.
Engagement is up! With what, unclear, but up.
Everything's content if you're brave enough.
We need a slogan. 'Nuts: they're nuts.'
Disruption? I invented that this morning.
mina: I dug a little too far again. Sorry about the floor.
The basement has a basement. I checked.
I can hear the nuts growing underground.
Down is just another kind of forward.
I found a fossil. It's a very old peanut.
The lab smells like the future. And ozone.
Everything's connected if you tunnel far enough.
idle: A nut rolls gently across the floor.
Dust motes drift in the warm light.
A distant squeak. Probably the chair.
The lamp flickers, cozy and warm.
The acorns are stacking up nicely.
Faint typing echoes through the trunk.
All quiet on the nut front.
upgrade: Efficiency is up! Pip pretends to understand why.
The office feels a little bigger already.
The team approves of this upgrade.
lowMorale: The office feels a little gloomy today.
Someone forgot to refill the snacks.
Morale is low. Marlow is on it.
The coffee ran out. This is serious.
A collective sigh echoes through the trunk.
focus: Focus mode: everyone's wearing serious hats now.
The team is locked in. So are you!
You've got this. We've got the nuts.
prestige: In a previous timeline, I also spilled that coffee.
I remember this. Or a version of it.
The multiverse is nutty, isn't it?
We've done this before. We'll do it better.
Every reset is just a fresh acorn.
interaction: You're the best boss. Don't tell the others.
Coffee? For me? You shouldn't have.
Ready to work my nuts off!
